title: Private Google backup and a personalized planner
notes: New: Optional Google sign-in and private Firebase backup use a separate Homework Planner account space.
Safe setup: Choose whether to use the cloud copy, move this device's planner, or start empty; data is never silently mixed.
New: First-run setup creates subjects and configures target grade, daily study capacity, reminders, haptics, and Reduce motion.
Redesigned: A cleaner Reminders-inspired interface uses clearer grouped lists, large titles, restrained colour, and improved light and dark contrast.
Improved: Sharp device-tuned haptics provide distinct tap, confirmation, completion, and warning feedback.
Offline first: The planner still works without an account or connection, and assignment photos stay on the device.
